- **Interior and Comfort:**
  - Black semi-aniline leather seats offering comfort and sophistication

- **Technology and Innovation:**
  - Advanced infotainment system designed for seamless connectivity
  - Smart safety features, including the latest driver assistance technologies
  - High-resolution display screens for enhanced visibility and control

The 2026 Lexus ESe 500e Luxury AWD is a celebration of Lexus’s dedication to innovative spirit and refined precision. Whether you're navigating through city streets or embarking on a long journey, this vehicle promises an experience that is both exhilarating and serene. Experience amazing with the new Lexus ESe. 🚗✨

This vehicle embodies the future of driving with its commitment to sustainable luxury, ensuring that every journey is as remarkable as the destination.

Introducing the 2026 Lexus ES 500e Premium AWD, a fully electric sedan that exemplifies the pinnacle of automotive innovation and luxury. The exterior is elegantly finished in Cloudburst Gray, giving it a sleek and sophisticated appearance that draws attention for all the right reasons.

Step inside, and you are greeted by the exquisite interior adorned with Palomino NuLuxe complemented by subtle Checkered trim, creating an atmosphere of refined elegance. The craftsmanship and attention to detail inside this vehicle ensure a truly remarkable driving experience.

The Lexus ES 500e Premium AWD is engineered with a state-of-the-art Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) engine, offering an advanced eco-friendly driving experience with zero emissions. This sophisticated sedan is equipped with an All-Wheel Drive (AWD) system and an electric transmission to provide excellent traction and seamless power delivery.

Key Features of the 2026 Lexus ES 500e Premium AWD include:

- **Advanced All-Wheel Drive (AWD):** Enhanced stability and control, suitable for a variety of road conditions.
- **Premium Interior:** Palomino NuLuxe seating surfaces paired with Checkered trim for a luxurious and comfortable cabin.
- **Innovative BEV Engine:** Environmentally conscious driving with zero emissions and efficient electric performance.
- **Sophisticated Exterior:** Finished in Cloudburst Gray, combining elegance with a modern aesthetic.
- **Cutting-edge Technology:** Laden with advanced technological features designed to enhance driving pleasure and convenience.

The 2026 Lexus ES 500e Premium AWD merges Lexus's commitment to quality, innovative spirit, and unparalleled craftsmanship. Discover an extraordinary driving experience inviting you to experience amazing with every journey. 🌟

This 2026 Chevrolet Equinox EV RS in Black is a forward-thinking AWD SUV powered by an electric motor delivering 300 hp and 355 lb-ft of torque. With an EPA-estimated 307-mile range, DC fast-charging capability, and a dual-level charge cord for both 120V and 240V charging, this Equinox EV is ready for daily drives and longer journeys.

Inside this Equinox EV RS, Adrenaline Red Evotex seat trim adds a sporty touch. Comfort features include heated front seats, an 8-way power driver seat, heated steering wheel, and automatic temperature control. The 17.7-inch advanced color LCD display, Google built-in navigation, SiriusXM with 360L, and a 6-speaker audio system keep you connected and entertained. The split folding rear seat and power liftgate make cargo handling easy.

Safety and convenience are enhanced with fully automatic headlights and a security system, giving you added peace of mind.

The exterior stands out with bold 21-inch black painted aluminum wheels, giving this Equinox EV RS a modern and confident look. Price includes Doc fee and any dealer added accessories.

This 2027 Chevrolet Bolt EV LT in Summit White offers efficient electric driving with a front-wheel drive electric propulsion system and 1-speed automatic. The EPA-estimated range is 262 miles on a full charge, and the electric motor delivers 210 horsepower. The dual level charge cord supports both 120-volt and 240-volt charging, making home or public charging flexible and convenient.

Inside this Bolt EV LT, you will find Jet Black Evotex seats with blue and gray stitching, heated and ventilated front seats, and an 8-way power driver seat for comfort. The 11.3 inch color LCD display with navigation powered by Google Maps, SiriusXM with 360L, and a 6-speaker audio system keep you connected and entertained. The heated steering wheel and split folding rear seat add extra convenience, while the Comfort and Evotex Packages enhance the overall experience.

Safety features include auto high-beam headlights, brake assist, fully automatic headlights, and a security system for peace of mind.

The exterior is highlighted by 17 inch silver painted aluminum wheels, giving this Bolt EV LT a modern look.

Visit our dealership today to test drive this Chevrolet Bolt EV LT and experience its electric efficiency, comfort, and advanced tech, or click learn more for pricing and finance options. Price includes Doc fee and any dealer added accessories.

This 1-owner 2024 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid Select in Bright White Clearcoat is powered by a 3.6L V6 engine paired with a CVT, offering efficient performance and front-wheel drive. The hybrid system makes it a practical choice for families seeking both space and fuel savings.

Inside this Pacifica, black Caprice leather bucket seats provide comfort for all passengers. The cabin features heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, a memory driver seat, and a split-bench third row with reclining capability. Technology highlights include a 10.1-inch Uconnect 5 Nav touchscreen with navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, SiriusXM 360L, integrated active noise cancellation, front dual zone A/C, rear air conditioning, and remote keyless entry.

Safety features include a rear parking camera, brake assist, fully automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, a security system, and heated exterior mirrors for added peace of mind.

The exterior stands out with 17-inch diamond cut wheels, a power liftgate, front fog lights, and heated, power-adjustable mirrors, blending style and convenience for everyday use.

description: Standard EquipmentComfortRear head restraint control: 3 rear seat head restraintsSeating capacity: 560-40 folding rear seat - Down for whatever. Sometimes you need a little more room for your cargo. Other times...you need a lot more room. 60-40 split folding rear seat provides you with added versatility so you can load passengers and cargo in multiple combinations. Fold one side down for long items and still have room for your passengers. Or fold both sides down to load large items. With 60-40 folding rear seat, it all fits.Automatic air conditioning - Constantly fiddling with the A-C controls to maintain the cabin temperature is frustrating and distracting. Automatic air conditioning takes care of it for you by automatically adjusting the thermostat and fan settings as needed to maintain the temperature you select. Keep your cool, with automatic air conditioning.Individual driver and front passenger seats provide generous room and comfort.Cabin air filter - breathing freshness into your drive. Cabin air filter increases everyone’s comfort by reducing allergens, dust and even outdoor odors that enter the vehicle.
